study_identification_part.si_4_title: A 10-Year Longitudinal Study of Brain Cortical Thickness in People with FirstEpisode Psychosis Using Normative Models

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: TOP longitudinal study; pooled public MRI datasets from 77 sites used for the reference normative model.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Design: Structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) from people with first-episode psychosis and controls ... within the Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study. Normative models for cortical thickness estimated on public MRI datasets (n = 42 983) were applied to TOP data..."; "Using pooled data from a collection of mostly publicly available datasets from 77 sites, and 40 435 participants..."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Berthet2025.pdf.md: Background / Design; Berthet2025.pdf.md: Normative Modeling

answer.TOP: clinical longitudinal dataset; used for transfer/adaptation with held-out CTRL from three Oslo scanners and for testing normative models on longitudinal CTRL and SCZ samples

answer.MULTI-DATASET (UNSPECIFIED OR N>=10): reference normative model training (95% healthy individuals) and validation (5% CTRL and patients) across 77 sites

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Reference normative model trained/validated on pooled public datasets; model adapted to Oslo scanners with held-out TOP CTRL, then tested on remaining longitudinal TOP CTRL/SCZ.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Using pooled data from a collection of mostly publicly available datasets from 77 sites, and 40 435 participants... the reference normative models were first trained on (95%) healthy individuals and validated on an independent set of 2548 CTRL and patients (5%, stratified by sites). We then adapted the model to the 3 unseen Oslo scanners... For this adaptation step, we used held-out cross-sectional data from CTRL from these 3 scanners... After this transfer step, we tested the normative models on the remaining longitudinal CTRL and SCZ samples"

model-1.overall-phase: 40435 healthy individuals for training; validation set includes 2548 CTRL+patients (HC count NR)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Model-1 training uses 40,435 participants (healthy individuals); validation set is 2,548 CTRL+patients (HC count not specified). Model-2 adaptation samples (CTRL only): TOP15 n=103, TOP3T n=294, TOP3T-GE n=393 (total 790).
